intro.h2: Kitchen cabinet painting with a quote that holds
paragraphs: Mike's Cabinet Painting is a small, family-run business: Mike and his wife Tiffany do the painting and answer the phone themselves. Kitchen cabinet painting is the job our customers mention first. One homeowner says her cabinets look brand new, and another hired us for her kitchen cabinets and walls in one go.

What reviewers come back to is how the job feels. Messages get returned promptly, even the questions you think are silly get patient answers, and the final bill matches the price we quoted at the start, with no hidden fees. The work moves quickly, too: fast work is the most common tag on our Google reviews.

services.h2: Kitchen cabinet painting, walls and whole rooms

items.name: Kitchen cabinet painting
items.blurb: Painting the cabinets you already have changes the whole kitchen without tearing anything out. The kitchen shown here has raised-panel doors in clean white with dark bar pulls. One customer says her cabinets look brand new, and another calls the results exceptional.

image.alt: Row of white raised-panel kitchen cabinets with black bar pulls above a black range and white subway tile

items.name: Kitchen walls and trim
items.blurb: Plenty of customers have us paint the kitchen walls during the same visit as the cabinets, so the room changes all at once. Here, soft gray walls frame white cabinets and a white subway tile backsplash. Ask about the trim while we are there, too.

image.alt: Bright kitchen with soft gray walls, white cabinets, white subway tile, a white island and three wooden counter stools

items.name: Living and dining room painting
items.blurb: Our brushes do not stop at the kitchen doorway. For one homeowner we painted walls and trim through her dining and living rooms as well, and she describes a flawless, even finish with not a single spot missed. Tell us which rooms you have in mind.

about.text: Mike's Cabinet Painting is run by Mike and his wife, Tiffany. Some customers know us simply as Mike's Painting, and the work goes beyond cabinets: kitchen walls, trim and whole living and dining rooms. Our Google profile holds a 5.0 rating from nine reviews, plus 31 photos of finished work. Homeowners describe us as accommodating and quick to reply, and one customer from four years ago says she would hire us again and recommend us to family and friends. We answer the phone seven days a week, from 8 AM to 10 PM.

process.h2: How a painting job with us works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (719) 696-4441 any day between 8 AM and 10 PM and tell us which cabinets, walls or rooms you want painted.

steps.title: Ask anything
steps.text: Bring every question you have. Customers say we answer each one with patience and get back to them quickly.

steps.title: Get a clear quote
steps.text: You get a price before any work starts. Reviewers say the final cost matched our quote, with no hidden fees added later.

steps.title: We paint
steps.text: We work efficiently and at a good pace, giving cabinets, walls and trim an even finish and checking that no spot is missed.

steps.title: Look it over together
steps.text: We go over the finished cabinets and walls with you, so you can check the result before we pack up.

items.name: Wendy N.
items.text:
I had the pleasure of hiring Mike's Painting for a comprehensive painting project in my home, and I'm thrilled with the results. From the outset, Tiffany and Mike demonstrated a level of responsiveness that is rare today. They promptly returned my messages and answered every crazy question I had with patience and professionalism.

The pricing was refreshingly fair, providing great value for the high-quality work I received. There were no hidden fees or unexpected costs, and they stuck to the initially quoted price.

The work itself was nothing short of perfection. The kitchen cabinets look brand new, and the walls, trim, dining, and living rooms boast a flawless, even finish that has completely transformed the space. Their attention to detail ensured that not a single spot was missed.

If you're looking for a painting company that combines expertise, great pricing, and outstanding customer service, look no further than Mike's Painting. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of top-notch painting services.

items.name: Elaine H.
items.text: I recently engaged Mike’s Painting to complete my kitchen cabinets and walls. Mike and his wife Tiffany delivered exceptional results, working efficiently, professionally and at a rapid pace. They are extremely accommodating and their pricing is very reasonable. I highly recommend their services, you will be thoroughly satisfied.

items.name: Kim L.
items.text: Thank you so much for your fast, extremely efficient and beautiful work to help make our kitchen dreams come true! You were a pleasure to hire for this project. Your professionalism and quick correspondence made everything so easy! I would definitely recommend Mike’s Painting to family and friends and use them again in the future!

service_area.text: Our Google listing does not show a town or service area yet, so the simplest way to find out whether we work near you is to ask. Call (719) 696-4441 any day from 8 AM to 10 PM, tell us where your home is and what you would like painted, and we will let you know right away whether it is in our area.

items.a: No. Kitchen cabinet painting is what most customers call us for, but we also paint kitchen walls, trim and other rooms. One homeowner had us do her cabinets plus the walls and trim in her dining and living rooms, and another booked her kitchen cabinets and walls together.

items.q: Will the price change once the job starts?
items.a: Our customers say it did not. One reviewer notes there were no hidden fees or unexpected costs and that we stuck to the price we first quoted. Another calls our pricing very reasonable. Call us to talk through your kitchen and get a quote before anything begins.

items.q: How long does cabinet painting take?
items.a: That depends on how many doors, drawers and rooms are involved, so we talk about timing when we quote your job. Customers consistently describe our work as fast and efficient, and fast work is the most common tag on our Google reviews.

We are open every day of the week from 8 AM to 10 PM, so evening and weekend calls are fine. Call (719) 696-4441 and we will get back to you promptly, which is something our reviewers mention again and again.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Call (719) 696-4441 or email mikespnr@gmail.com with a few photos of your kitchen and any other rooms you want painted. We will ask a few questions about the space, answer all of yours and give you a clear price before any work begins, so you know the cost up front.
